snippet.title: Bounty Brawl - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Welcome to Hunter Haven! Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted is a fast-paced Action Roguelite for 1-4 players. Master your unique Lasso to zip through combat and hunt down criminals with friends. But remember: once the boss falls, the alliance ends. Who will claim the ultimate bounty? Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted will be available on PC in April 2026.
